prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: monochrome pixel art environmental TILE SHEET for an Arduboy FX creature-collecting top-down JRPG.
Primary request: A new 32x32 pixel per tile experiment, WHITE BASE BACKGROUND, heavy intentional black/white dithering, early Pokemon Game Boy style top-down JRPG environment art.
Create one square atlas: exactly 8 columns and 8 rows of equally sized tiles, no gutters, no grid lines, no captions, no outer margin. Logical sheet resolution 256x256; present enlarged with nearest-neighbor crisp pixels. Each tile is logically exactly 32x32 pixels. All visible pixels belong to a chunky native 32x32 grid, no subpixel fine detail.
Palette: pure BLACK and WHITE only. No colors, no gray, no smooth shading, no antialiasing.
Perspective: classic overhead JRPG, see roofs and tree crowns from above, short front faces on buildings, orthogonal horizontal/vertical alignment, never isometric.
Art direction: white open ground across every prop cell; strong clean black silhouettes with recognizable white highlights. HEAVY organized 1px checkerboard and clustered stipple dithering in tree canopies, grass clumps, rocks, roof shadows, brickwork and water. Texture belongs within material silhouettes; no black square backplates behind props, no noisy dithering filling all empty ground. Tiles feel coherent, original, charming and readable.
Exact row-major contents, eight cells per row:
Row 1: white bare ground; sparse meadow tufts; dense tall grass; flowers; pale pebble path; pale cobblestone path; sandy ground; marsh reeds.
Row 2: broadleaf tree; pine tree; rounded shrub; hedge; stump; fallen log; berry bush; mushroom cluster.
Row 3: small rock; boulder; rocky cliff top; rocky cliff front; cave entrance; ruined column; stone arch; crystal cluster.
Row 4: water center horizontal ripples on WHITE base; north shore; south shore; west shore; east shore; northwest shore corner; northeast shore corner; small pond.
Row 5: horizontal wood fence; vertical wood fence; fence corner; wooden gate; signpost; well; crate; barrel.
Row 6: cottage roof upper left; cottage roof upper middle; cottage roof upper right; shop roof upper left; shop roof upper middle; shop roof upper right; horizontal bridge deck; vertical bridge deck.
Row 7: cottage front lower left; cottage front door lower middle; cottage front lower right; shop front lower left; shop front door lower middle; shop front lower right; dock end; wooden stairs.
Row 8: floorboards; stone interior floor; brick wall; bookshelf; table; bed; planter; shrine.
Row 6 columns 1-3 and row 7 columns 1-3 together make one contiguous 96x64 pixel cottage, roof above shallow facade, door at bottom middle. Columns 4-6 of those rows make a matching shop. No separate isolated little house in each building tile. Other props fit cleanly within one 32x32 cell with modest white clearance.
Constraints: sprite atlas only, absolutely no text, no people, no Pokemon characters, no logos, no decorative borders, no presentation mockup, no perspective tilt. Crisp deliberate pixel shapes and dither at logical game-pixel scale. White base remains dominant across the sheet.
